annotations.title: Create a formula on your bench

description: Use this when the user wants a new formula on their PerfuMate bench, empty or with lines they give (structured, pasted text or an attached file), for example after building one together in this chat. Lines are matched to the catalog and the user's own materials; if any line does not match, nothing is saved and the unmatched names come back with suggestions. Bottles the user does not own are added off the shelf, as an import does. To only check a formula without saving it use check_formula.

batchGrams.description: Batch size when lines are in percent. Default 10 g.

file.description: A file the user attached in the chat: CSV, TSV, TXT, JSON or Excel (.xlsx).

dilutionPct.description: Strength of the bottle weighed, e.g. 10 for a 10% dilution.

grams.description: Weighed amount in grams. Never send together with percent.

material.description: Name, trade name or CAS as written, e.g. "Iso E Super" or "Ambroxan 10% in DPG".

newMaterial.description: Only for a material the catalog does not have: create it as the user's own material.

percent.description: Weighed share of the formula, when every line is percent. Never send together with grams. Not the bottle dilution.

solvent.description: The dilution's solvent, e.g. DPG, IPM, ethanol.

text.description: The formula as pasted text, one material per line with an amount.

name: create_formula
